notes: Machine-readable wiki database for the Maktaba spec. Renders alongside the markdown pages in docs/wiki/. Linear issue IDs are null because the upstream specs do not yet carry Linear back-references; the field is reserved for future use.

entries.title: API Server
entries.content: Go API Service. Every request that isn't a media byte: library CRUD, search, job control, settings, watch state, real-time WebSocket fan-out, gRPC client surface to Pipeline and Streaming. Stateless behind Postgres; one binary scales horizontally without session affinity.

entries.title: HTTP server skeleton, problem+json, request IDs
entries.content: chi-based HTTP server, RFC 9457 problem+json error envelope, UUID v7 request IDs, structured logging via slog, graceful shutdown, idempotency-key replay store.

entries.title: Cursor pagination primitive
entries.content: Shared cursor pagination across all list endpoints. Opaque base64 cursor, no offset.

entries.title: Library CRUD endpoints
entries.content: GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE for /libraries. Multi-root and validation surfaces handled here; behavior in epic 9.

entries.title: Video listing, detail, patch, delete
entries.content: List, retrieve, partial-update, and delete videos with cursor pagination and rich filters.

entries.title: Video processing control
entries.content: Start, restart, pause, resume, cancel processing for a video.

entries.title: Transcript window endpoint
entries.content: Window-paginated transcript segments around a target time.

entries.title: Subtitles & chapters read endpoints
entries.content: Read-only access to subtitle tracks and chapter lists for a video.

entries.title: Search API (FTS, semantic, hybrid)
entries.content: Three search modes via one endpoint with mode toggle. Targets p50 ≤ 250 ms on 100k-segment fixture.

entries.title: Saved searches
entries.content: Persisted user search queries; consumed by smart collections (9.14).

entries.title: Streaming session lifecycle
entries.content: Create / get / close streaming sessions; mints session JWTs via 10.8 and calls Streaming OpenSession via gRPC.

entries.title: Watch progress sync
entries.content: Per-user, per-video watch position; debounced PUT, cursor read.

entries.title: Job control endpoints
entries.content: Pause / resume / cancel / retry for individual queue jobs.

entries.title: Queue stats endpoint
entries.content: Aggregate per-stage counts and bottleneck signals.

entries.title: Collections, tags, speakers endpoints
entries.content: CRUD for organization primitives whose behavior is in epic 9.

entries.title: Settings & system endpoints
entries.content: Read/write app settings; STT backend probe; system meta.

entries.title: WebSocket fan-out
entries.content: Postgres LISTEN/NOTIFY → WebSocket fan-out per user. No Redis or in-process bus.

entries.title: GraphQL schema + resolvers
entries.content: Single /graphql endpoint layered over the REST resolvers. Generated TS types in shared/graphql/schema.graphql.

entries.title: gRPC clients to Pipeline and Streaming
entries.content: Code-generated gRPC clients; load-balanced and connection-pooled; integrates with story 7.10.

entries.title: Validation, body/query limits, rate limiting
entries.content: Schema validation on all writes; body size caps; per-IP and per-user token-bucket rate limits.

entries.title: Health, version, metrics, observability
entries.content: Liveness/readiness, build-version endpoint, Prometheus /metrics. OpenTelemetry traces.

entries.title: Recommendations endpoint
entries.content: Per-user recommendations from semantic features and watch history.

entries.title: Device registration for push
entries.content: Register / list / revoke device push tokens. Required by mobile epic for push fan-out.

entries.title: Streaming Service
entries.content: Go Streaming Service. Every media byte: HLS / DASH manifests, range-served direct play, FFmpeg-driven transcode and remux, live subtitle muxing, sprite/poster serving, session-pinned adaptive playback. Validates JWTs offline against the API's published JWKS so a playing video survives an API restart.

entries.title: Server skeleton, signed URL middleware, metrics
entries.content: Streaming service chassis. All paths validate JWTs offline against the JWKS published by 10.6.

entries.title: Capability matrix and client profile registry
entries.content: Maps client → supported codecs / containers / DRM tiers. Picks playback mode (direct / remux / transcode).

entries.title: Direct play (range-served 206 Partial Content)
entries.content: Pass-through byte range serving when client supports the source format.

entries.title: Direct stream (FFmpeg -c copy remux)
entries.content: Container-only remux when codecs are compatible but container isn't (e.g. MKV → MP4).

entries.title: HLS adaptive transcode pipeline
entries.content: Full FFmpeg transcode to multi-rendition HLS. Canonical adaptive format.

entries.title: DASH manifest (opt-in per session)
entries.content: DASH alternative to HLS, opt-in at session create.

entries.title: Hardware acceleration auto-detect
entries.content: VAAPI / NVENC / VideoToolbox probing; auto-fallback to software encode on probe failure.

entries.title: gRPC server: OpenSession / CloseSession / EvictHashCache / GetCapabilities
entries.content: Inter-service contract consumed by the API binary (story 7.10 / 7.18).

entries.title: Session store, sticky transcoder, reaper
entries.content: Session store pins each session to a single Streaming host. Reaper closes idle sessions.

entries.title: Concurrency caps, backpressure, slot accounting
entries.content: Per-host slot accounting; over-cap requests get 503 Retry-After, never connection drops.

entries.title: Live subtitle rendering (auto, sidecar, embedded)
entries.content: Mux subtitles into HLS at request time from auto-generated VTT, sidecar files, or embedded streams.

entries.title: Chapter delivery (HLS DATERANGE + sidecar JSON)
entries.content: Inline HLS DATERANGE tags and a sidecar JSON for non-HLS players.

entries.title: Posters, sprite sheets, chapter thumbs serving
entries.content: Static derivation artifacts served behind streaming-static JWT scope.

entries.title: Cache layout, LRU GC, cap enforcement
entries.content: On-disk cache for HLS segments and probe artifacts; LRU eviction; configurable cap.

entries.title: Probe cache (LRU + Postgres)
entries.content: FFprobe results memoized in Postgres + LRU; eviction triggered by file-hash change.

entries.title: Library Management
entries.content: Long-lived behaviors that turn a folder on disk into a curated, browsable catalog: filesystem watching, dedup, auto-categorization, organization primitives (collections, smart collections, tags, speakers), library lifecycle, chapter inference.

entries.title: Library config schema and validation
entries.content: JSON schema for library configuration. Multi-root rejection happens at write time.

entries.title: Filesystem watcher (debounced, settling-aware)
entries.content: Python watchdog observer per library. Debounced; waits for size and mtime to settle before ingest.

entries.title: Periodic full sweep (sparse, idempotent)
entries.content: Cadence-driven catch-up sweep that fills gaps when the watcher misses events.

entries.title: Content-hash dedup (move/rename/copy detection)
entries.content: Partial-content hash (head + tail + length) avoids full-file reads on large files.

entries.title: Ignore rules and supported-extension filtering
entries.content: .gitignore-style ignore rules + extension allowlist applied before any pipeline work.

entries.title: Manual scan trigger and scan progress
entries.content: API-triggered scan with progress events surfaced over WebSocket.

entries.title: Library stats query
entries.content: < 50 ms target; trigger-maintained cache table backs the query.

entries.title: Auto-categorization: language tag
entries.content: Per-video language detection from the transcribe stage output.

entries.title: Auto-categorization: topic tag (k-means recluster)
entries.content: K-means recluster of segment embeddings; centroids re-computed on cadence.

entries.title: Auto-categorization: content type classifier
entries.content: Music vs speech vs hybrid signal from probe metrics.

entries.title: Speakers, voiceprints, naming, merge
entries.content: Cluster diarized voices into speaker entities; rename, merge, split.

entries.title: Tag CRUD and normalization
entries.content: User-defined and auto tags. Lowercase / collapse-whitespace normalization at write.

entries.title: Collections (manual, ordered)
entries.content: Manual ordered playlists of videos.

entries.title: Smart collections (saved-search-backed)
entries.content: A smart collection is a name + saved-search ID + ordering policy. Zero duplication of the search logic.

entries.title: Library deletion (catalog vs file purge)
entries.content: Two modes: catalog-only (preserves files) and full purge (deletes both). Cascade through videos → streaming_sessions.

entries.title: Multi-root and overlap detection
entries.content: Reject two libraries claiming overlapping roots; warn on near-overlap.

entries.title: Library audit log
entries.content: Append-only audit rows for library mutations. Shares the canonical audit_log table with epic 10 (story 10.16) — distinguished by category column.

entries.title: Chapter inference from transcript topic shifts
entries.content: Heuristic chapter boundaries from segment-embedding topic transitions.

entries.title: Auth & Security
entries.content: Identity, sessions, signed URLs, secret handling, transport hardening. Two surfaces, one identity: web cookies + CSRF and native bearer JWT + refresh. Streaming verifies JWTs offline against the API's published JWKS. First epic to land — Epic 7 endpoints depend on this epic's primitives.

entries.title: User store + argon2id password hashing
entries.content: users table with argon2id password hashes. Sentinel UUID 00000000-...-001 reserved for single-user mode.

entries.title: Web login (cookie + CSRF)
entries.content: httpOnly auth cookie + readable csrf_token cookie. CSRF middleware (10.10) checks header on every state-changing request.

entries.title: Native login (JWT access + opaque refresh)
entries.content: RS256 JWT access (short TTL) + opaque refresh (argon2id-hashed at rest, family-bound).

entries.title: Token refresh + rotation
entries.content: Refresh rotation: every refresh issues a new opaque token. Reuse of a revoked refresh token revokes the entire family.

entries.title: Logout + session revocation
entries.content: Web: revoke web_session row. Native: revoke entire refresh family.

entries.title: RS256 key generation, rotation, JWKS publication
entries.content: RS256 keypair lifecycle. JWKS endpoint published for offline verifiers.

entries.title: Streaming-side offline JWT verification
entries.content: Streaming caches JWKS and verifies session JWTs without calling the API. Library-scoped lib[] claim enforces per-segment authorization.

entries.title: Signed-URL minter (manifest, direct, sidecar)
entries.content: Single minter consumed by API to produce streaming URLs. Auds: streaming, streaming-direct, streaming-static, api.

entries.title: Single-user mode (admin token bypass)
entries.content: Opt-in single-user/admin token bypass. Audit attribution uses sentinel UUID.

entries.title: CSRF protection (web only)
entries.content: Double-submit cookie pattern: csrf_token cookie + matching X-CSRF-Token header on every state-changing web request.

entries.title: Brute-force / credential-stuffing protection
entries.content: Per-account failed-attempts counter + locked_until. Backoff increases on repeated failures.

entries.title: Rate limiting on auth endpoints
entries.content: Per-IP and per-user token-bucket on /auth/* — separate from generic API rate limiting (7.19).

entries.title: Permission model (admin vs viewer; resource scope)
entries.content: Admin / viewer split for v1. Permission middleware checks is_admin and resource ownership.

entries.title: Secret loading and redaction
entries.content: Secrets loaded from env / file / KMS. log redaction filter strips known-secret patterns.

entries.title: Transport security (TLS, HSTS, secure cookies, CORS)
entries.content: TLS termination, HSTS, secure cookies, restrictive CORS allowlist. Mandatory in production.

entries.title: Audit log for security-sensitive actions
entries.content: Writes category='security' rows to the canonical audit_log table owned by epic 9.

entries.content: 8-char base32 pairing code displayed on signed-in device, claimed by new device.
